description.zh: 审计管理员账号名称。>若已开启三权分立模式，该参数必填。更多关于三权分立模块的信息，请参见[三权分立](~~213824~~)。
description.en: The name of the audit administrator account. > If the three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. For more information about the three-role mode, see [Three-role mode](~~213824~~).

description.zh: 审计管理员账号的密码。>若已开启三权分立模式，该参数必填。更多关于三权分立模块的信息，请参见[三权分立](~~213824~~)。
description.en: The password of the audit administrator account. > If the three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. For more information about the three-role mode, see [Three-role mode](~~213824~~).

description.zh: 实例id。>您可以调用[describedbinstances](~~196830~~)接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例id。
description.en: The instance ID. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all instances in the specified region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 实例所在地域id。>您可以调用[describeregions](~~196841~~)接口查看polardb-x支持的地域详情，包括地域id。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.

descriptions.zh: > SQL审计与分析功能关闭后将不再向日志服务写入数据，但您仍可以查看历史数据，这部分历史数据会产生存储和索引费用。您可以通过删除所有数据来停用日志服务，日志停止服务后将不再计费。关于停用日志服务，详情请参见[停用日志服务](~~90650~~)。
descriptions.en: > After the SQL audit and analysis feature is disabled, data is no longer written to Simple Log Service. However, you can still view historical data, which incurs storage and indexing fees. You can delete all data to deactivate Simple Log Service. After Simple Log Service is deactivated, no further fees are incurred. For more information about deactivating Simple Log Service, see [Deactivate Simple Log Service](~~90650~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx disable-sql-audit --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id pxc-0000000000000000 --audit-account-name test_daa --audit-account-password Pw@11111 --region cn-hangzhou
